abort.already_configured: This heat meter is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port or read the meter. Check the port and the logs.
error.invalid_response: The meter answered, but the answer contained no current values. Try again in a minute; if it persists, please open an issue with the debug log.
error.no_response: The meter did not answer. Check that the optical head sits centred on the meter's optical interface.

user.title: Optical reading head
user.description: Select the serial port of the IR reading head attached to the heat meter. The meter is read once to identify it; this takes a few seconds.

data_description.scan_interval: Every readout wakes the battery-powered meter. The manufacturer allows at most one readout per minute.

meter_changed.message: The meter on {port} reports the identification {found} instead of {expected}. If the meter was replaced, remove this entry and add the new meter.
